label: copy-phase fed-back f, especially when the next output is b or f
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the fed-back input is the letter f (in_tok=f covers 99.8% of activations and 99.95% of mass, but just 2% of copy-phase f inputs are active). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on any other input (3 stray activations on b). Strongly gated by the token being output: out_tok=b (60% of mass, 31x lift) and out_tok=f (24%, i.e. repeated ff) dominate, with weaker z/s/p. Magnitude is largest early in a long copy (recall_idx 3-4, L=9, many outputs left), e.g. top example o o f b p l s t -> f at recall 2 outputting b. Never at recall_idx 0-1. Even with the b/f restriction, precision is only about 0.3: many f->b steps in short sequences or late in the copy stay silent.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=f (+6.10), in_tok=f (+3.71), phase=2 & out_tok=b (+3.61), out_tok=b (+3.50), next_out=b (+3.48), phase=2 & out_tok=f (+2.73). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.34), recall_idx=1 (-2.49), prev_tok=<DEL> (-2.49), prev_tok=s (-2.29).
